effects.description: The second closest individual to the caster throws up a mouthful of copper coins.
The caster's teeth fall out, then grow back over the next minute.
Every flame in the scene turns cold for ten minutes.
A furious goose appears inside the caster's clothing.
The spell's target becomes strongly magnetic for one minute.
The caster's last meal reappears intact on a plate at their feet.
A bell rings above the caster's head whenever they lie for the next hour.
The wand turns into a live eel for ten minutes.
